notes.title: INTERGALACTIC ECSTASY, a new Erotic Adventure/RPG arrives in one week!

Fight your way through a number of alien worlds in Third-Person-Shooter action, and guide Penny as she completes a number of intense sexual challenges to earn the fabled Erotesian stones, the keys to a civilization where fun, casual sex is a way of life.

This new Erotic Adventure by HFTGames features:

A Super-Sexy Erotic StoryNumerous Interactive Sex ScenesProfessional Voice-OverFull Realtime 3D GameplaySTEAM Achievements
